corroboration.web_search: 27 October 2026: searches restricted to ramp.com found no page about the campaign or the Instagram account; trade press (WERSM, Shredder, theinspiration.com, TheaterMania) attributes both campaigns to Ramp but is not an official Ramp source.
corroboration.reasoning: No official Ramp source names or links @tryramp. The account's profile links a campaign site, and that site's self-description is not conclusive. The matching funding post and the X handle are consistent with Ramp but do not establish who runs the account. The 19 records are kept and counted, labelled unresolved, and no conclusion about Ramp rests on them.
